title: hieracium lanifolium subsp. aemuliforme
intro: Hieracium lanifolium subsp. aemuliforme, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic, making it beneficial for the treatment of urinary tract infections and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium lanifolium subsp. aemuliforme include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect the body against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
